svg.title: Customize callout context menus
svg.desc: The actual MenuCustomizationModal renders its production toggles and drag handles. Delete section is disabled in the synthetic heading-menu configuration, exposing the disabled band and the real category reset arrow. The dark-mode window scrolls within its height limit.
